Vmo 243 KIAS from FAA TCDS A13NM (DHC-8-300): the 0-17,000 ft band maximum (232 kt at 20,000 ft, 214 kt at 25,000 ft, the ceiling). TCDS gives no Mmo; the class M0.55 stands. The descent speeds fly 10 kt under the TCDS Vmo bands: descentSpeedFl100 233 (243 - 10) replaces the profile's 250, which flew past Vmo, and descentSpeedInitial 204 (214 - 10, the Vmo at the 25,000 ft ceiling, M0.497 there) replaces the profile's 0, which skipped the breakpoint and held 250 to the ceiling. The straight line between stays at least 10 kt under every band (219.5 at 17,000 ft, 213.7 at 20,000 ft).

Vmo and Mmo 0.60 from FAA TCDS A13NM (DHC-8-400). vmoBands: 245 kt to 8,000 ft, a straight line to 282 kt at 10,000 ft and on to 286 kt at 18,000 ft, held above; vmo 286 is the band maximum. The TCDS's 275 kt at 20,000 ft and 248 kt at 25,000 ft are each about M0.599 (as is 286/18,000), the Mmo 0.60 line, so the scalar Mmo carries them. The Q400 flies DH8C's profile through the sibling map, and an override with profile fields merges onto that profile, so it carries its own descent speeds: descentSpeedFl100 235 (245 - 10, the band at 8,000 ft: DH8C's profile 250 carried the line from the approach speed past 245 - 10 between 7,500 and 8,200 ft) and descentSpeedInitial 238 (248 - 10 at the 25,000 ft ceiling, M0.576), not DH8C's 233/204.

Vmo from FAA TCDS A21EU (Jetstream Series 200). vmoBands: 215 kt to 18,000 ft, then a straight line down to 180 kt at 25,000 ft, the ceiling; vmo 215 is the band maximum. TCDS gives no Mmo; the class M0.55 never binds below this Vmo up to the ceiling. finalApproachSpeed 105 is the Eurocontrol APD Vat. The descent speeds fly 10 kt under the TCDS Vmo bands, as SMAX does: descentSpeedFl100 205 (215 - 10) replaces the profile's 220, which flew past Vmo, and descentSpeedInitial 170 (180 - 10, the Vmo at 25,000 ft, the ceiling) replaces the profile's 1, which reads as 1 KIAS and dragged the descent speed toward 1 kt near the ceiling.
